description: Daily terrestrial-AIS records of cargo and tanker traffic at 15 United States port complexes, 2015-2025 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Abduxoliq Ashuraliyev (Independent Researcher, Tashkent, Uzbekistan). Erratum (2026-08-14). Line 5 of the deposited README.md gives this record's DOI as 10.5281/zenodo.21653033. That is the DOI of version 1.0.0; the correct version DOI for this record is 10.5281/zenodo.21936231. The concept DOI shown on the same line, 10.5281/zenodo.21653032, is correct. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
